p=Path('programs/task-cab37516.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Find horizontal stripes and their one-cell gaps, then extend the first
    # encountered gap color upward in each gap column.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(out),len(out[0])
    first={}
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        # Rows with nonzero horizontal content are stripe rows.
        if not any(row):
            continue
        # Fill zero holes bracketed by the same nonzero color.
        for c in range(1,w-1):
            if row[c]==0 and row[c-1]!=0 and row[c+1]==row[c-1]:
                out[r][c]=row[c-1]
                first.setdefault(c,(r,row[c-1]))
    # Extend the topmost stripe's gap color to the top edge.
    for c,(r,color) in first.items():
        for rr in range(r):
            if out[rr][c]==0:
                out[rr][c]=color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
